newsitem.title: USA: Gryphon Holdings to add to reserves in Q4.
newsitem.headline: Gryphon Holdings to add to reserves in Q4.

text.p: Gryphon Holdings Inc said Friday it plans to add to its reserves in the fourth quarter for several truck leasing accounts.

President and Chief Executive Stephen Crane said in a statement that the company could not at this point estimate the probable amount of the strengthening, except that "additional loss reserves, if any, will not be of a magnitude sufficient to materially affect Gryphon's financial health."
Crane added that "our objective will be to deal with it at year-end and minimize the impact on future results of any discontinued program or line of business."
